title: Cyber extensions
description: Private authorized-lab security extension surface. It is separate from the normal desktop dashboard and is exposed only in a private build with the feature flag on.

authorization.banner: AUTHORIZED USE ONLY. Use this surface only on systems you own or for which you hold explicit, written permission. Define an explicit target scope before running any tool, and stop and clear the scope when finished.
authorization.acknowledgement: I have explicit written authorization that names the in-scope systems and time window.
authorization.labConfirmationLabel: I confirm this Nmap scan targets an authorized lab or private network.
authorization.setConfirmationLabel: I confirm this SET launch is limited to systems I own or am explicitly authorized in writing to test.
authorization.captureConfirmationLabel: I confirm this capture and any opened pcap are limited to traffic, systems, and media I own or am explicitly authorized in writing to examine.
authorization.openConfirmationLabel: I confirm this capture file is local, I am authorized to examine it, and it will not be uploaded or transmitted.
authorization.sensitivePayloadWarning: Captures can contain credentials, tokens, cookies, private keys, and personal data. Payloads and sensitive fields are redacted from the summary, but the raw capture remains sensitive. Never upload or auto-transmit a capture.
authorization.dualUseWarning: SET is a dual-use social-engineering framework. Use it only on systems you own or are explicitly authorized in writing to test. Phishing, credential harvesting, and payload delivery are prohibited.
authorization.labVmWarning: LAB ONLY: the default VM network is isolated, has no host bridge, and cannot route to the host LAN. Keep target traffic inside this network unless you deliberately choose the warned host-LAN option.
authorization.hostLanWarning: WARNING: Attaching this VM to the host LAN removes lab isolation. The guest can reach real hosts, services, and the internet. Do this only on a network you own or are explicitly authorized to use, and take a clean snapshot before changing the VM network.
authorization.hostLanConfirmationLabel: I understand this VM will leave the isolated LAB ONLY network, can reach the host LAN, and that I have authorization and a clean snapshot.
authorization.snapshotGuidance: Before any target runs, create a clean baseline snapshot of the powered-off qcow2 VM. Revert to it after each exercise, and take a fresh snapshot before changing the network or installing untrusted media. Never store credentials, captured secrets, or production data in a snapshot.
authorization.targetScopeLabel: Target scope (owned or explicitly authorized only)

tabs.title: Nmap
tabs.description: Explicit, operator-started network mapping for an authorized target scope.

tool.installHint: Nmap is part of the reviewed core image. If it is missing, install it from the reviewed package source or work without this tab.

tabs.title: SET
tabs.description: Social-Engineer Toolkit launcher/status panel. SET is dual-use. This tab detects an operator-installed SET and launches it only after an explicit, authorized-lab confirmation; it bundles and generates no targets, templates, phishing pages, credential harvesters, or payloads.

policy.reason: SET is admitted only as an operator-installed, explicitly confirmed dual-use launcher. This frontend ships no attack content and generates no target, template, phishing page, credential harvester, or payload.

tool.installHint: SET is not shipped in this image. If an operator-installed copy is present, this tab detects it through the host probe; otherwise no command is run. Adding SET to the image requires a separate policy review.

tabs.title: Wireshark / Forensics
tabs.description: Explicit, operator-started local capture and read-only pcap inspection with tshark. No capture starts automatically, no packet is injected, and no capture is uploaded. Payloads and sensitive fields are redacted from the summary.

policy.reason: The forensics tab opens local captures read-only and can start an explicit tshark capture when the host grants capture capability. It has no packet-injection or upload path.

tool.installHint: tshark is part of the reviewed Wireshark core image. Without it, pcap parsing is unavailable and no command is run. Captures opened here must be local media you own or are authorized to examine.

tabs.title: Lab / VM
tabs.description: Isolated QEMU/libvirt lab launcher. It generates a domain on the default LAB ONLY network, includes snapshot guidance, and warns before any host-LAN attachment. No VM, bridge, network, or service starts by itself.

policy.reason: The lab launcher defaults to an isolated libvirt network with no host bridge. Host-LAN attachment is an explicit, warned, non-default path that also requires an operator-supplied existing bridge.

tool.installHint: The isolated QEMU/libvirt lab baseline is part of the reviewed core image. Use the generated LAB ONLY network by default and keep lab traffic inside a network you own and control.
